title: PARL stabilizes mitochondrial BCL-2 via Nur77-mediated scaffolding as a therapeutic strategy for Parkinson's disease.
authors: Yin, Shiyi; Zhai, Yibo; Song, Run; Wu, Jiannan; Zhang, Yongjiang; Yu, Miao; Ma, Hongxia; Shen, Mengmeng; Lai, Xiaoyi; Jin, Weina; Xu, Yunqi; Yan, Junqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PARL与Nur77在帕金森病中的线粒体凋亡调控机制，虽用AlphaFold2建模但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) involves both mitochondrial dysfunction and Lewy body pathology. However molecular links between these features remain unclear. Here, we identify Presenilin-associated rhomboid-like protein (PARL) as a Lewy body component, RARL regulates mitochondrial apoptosis via interacting with orphan nuclear receptor Nur77. Clinical profiling revealed reduced plasma PARL levels in 71 PD patients versus controls (p < 0.001), which correlated with disease severity. In MPP(+)/MPTP models, PARL depletion amplified BAX activation and caspase-3 cleavage, driving neuronal death. Mechanistically, mitochondrial translocation of Nur77 stabilized PARL-BCL-2 complexes, suppressing apoptosis. AlphaFold2-guided structural modeling uncovered a PARL alpha-helix essential for Nur77 binding. Disrupting this interface abolished BCL-2 stabilization. Parl knockdown exacerbated motor/cognitive deficits in MPTP mice, rescued by Nur77 overexpression. Subcellular tracking demonstrated Nur77 nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling dynamically regulates PARL-BCL-2 assembly, while co-immunoprecipitation confirmed Nur77 knockdown dissociates this complex. Our findings define the Nur77-PARL axis as a critical mitochondrial gatekeeper in PD, where PARL serves dual roles as a Lewy body constituent and apoptosis regulator. Reduced circulating PARL levels may reflect disease progression, while the Nur77-PARL structural interface offers a therapeutic target for neuroprotection. This study bridges Lewy body biology with mitochondrial apoptosis. It proposes biomarker-driven strategies to modulate BCL-2-dependent neuronal survival in PD. Schematic summary. In normal neuronal cells, PARL can inhibit the release of apoptotic signals by interacting with Nur77. In the MPP(+)-induced PD model, PARL expression is reduced inhibits the apoptosis of dopaminergic neurons, and reduces cell viability. Mechanistic schema: Normal state: PARL-Nur77 complex stabilizes mitochondrial membrane integrity, inhibiting BCL-2 ubiquitination. MPP+ injury: PARL downregulation disrupts Nur77 binding, triggering BAX oligomerization and caspase-3 activation. Therapeutic rescue: Nur77 overexpression restores PARL-mediated anti-apoptotic signaling.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）涉及线粒体功能障碍和路易体病理。然而，这些特征之间的分子联系仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定出早老素相关菱形样蛋白（Presenilin-associated rhomboid-like protein, PARL）为路易体成分，PARL通过孤儿核受体Nur77相互作用调节线粒体凋亡。临床分析显示，71例PD患者血浆PARL水平较对照组降低（p < 0.001），且与疾病严重程度相关。在MPP(+)/MPTP模型中，PARL缺失放大BAX激活和caspase-3裂解，驱动神经元死亡。机制上，Nur77的线粒体转位稳定PARL-BCL-2复合物，抑制凋亡。AlphaFold2引导的结构建模揭示了PARL中一个对Nur77结合至关重要的α-螺旋。破坏该界面消除BCL-2稳定化。Parl敲低加剧MPTP小鼠的运动/认知缺陷，而Nur77过表达可挽救此效应。亚细胞追踪显示Nur77核-胞质穿梭动态调节PARL-BCL-2组装，而免疫共沉淀证实Nur77敲低使该复合物解离。我们的发现将Nur77-PARL轴定义为PD中关键的线粒体守门员，其中PARL兼具路易体成分和凋亡调节因子的双重角色。循环PARL水平降低可能反映疾病进展，而Nur77-PARL结构界面为神经保护提供治疗靶点。本研究桥接路易体生物学与线粒体凋亡，提出基于生物标志物的策略以调节PD中BCL-2依赖性神经元存活。示意图总结：在正常神经元细胞中，PARL通过与Nur77相互作用抑制凋亡信号释放。在MPP(+)-诱导的PD模型中，PARL表达降低抑制多巴胺能神经元凋亡，并降低细胞活力。机制示意图：正常状态：PARL-Nur77复合物稳定线粒体膜完整性，抑制BCL-2泛素化。MPP+损伤：PARL下调破坏Nur77结合，触发BAX寡聚化和caspase-3激活。治疗性挽救：Nur77过表达恢复PARL介导的抗凋亡信号。
